name: RAG corpus health, eval drilldown, and source-task controls
objective: Make RAG quality diagnosable and actionable from /admin/discord without requiring Supabase inspection or CLI-only workflows.
implemented: Added lib/rag/admin-health.ts with deterministic RAG corpus health summarization.
Added eval failure drilldown classification with retrieval hit, citation coverage, faithfulness, missing sources, missing terms, trace ID, answer ID, severity, and suggested fix.
Extended /admin/discord with a RAG operational health panel showing source/document/chunk/embedding counts, missing coverage, latest ingestion run, latest eval run, and issues.
Extended /admin/discord with a RAG eval drilldown table for latest eval results.
Added an authenticated admin action that turns a failed eval into a deduped discord_content_queue knowledge/source task.
Added Playwright proof that seeds a failed eval, renders the drilldown, clicks Create source task, verifies the content queue row, and cleans up.
Re-ran the existing Phase 7 dashboard RAG sync E2E to prove no regression.

verification.evidence: 1 Chromium test passed. The test proved failed eval drilldown visibility and Create source task action into discord_content_queue.
1 Chromium test passed. Existing Phase 7 dashboard approve/sync RAG flow still works.
runKey smoke-20260624214222; 3/3 passed; passRate 1; retrievalHitRate 1; citationCoverage 1
Next.js production build completed successfully. Existing non-blocking warnings remain for middleware deprecation, edge runtime static generation behavior, and academy cookie-based dynamic rendering.

what_is_real: Admin can now see live RAG source/document/chunk/embedding counts.
Admin can see latest ingestion and eval run posture.
Admin can inspect failed evals with missing source/term details and trace/answer IDs.
Admin can create a concrete source/content task from a failed eval without leaving /admin/discord.
what_is_left: Phase 9 must build the real Discord capture pipeline so persistent community questions, answers, resources, and wins become reviewable knowledge candidates.
One-click chunk/embed/eval job triggers are still not fully dashboard-native; Phase 14 durable jobs should own safe retryable job triggering.
The broad full RAG eval still needs to remain above the 95% target as the corpus grows; this pass proved the smoke eval and drilldown workflow.
next_phase: Phase 9 - real Discord capture pipeline and knowledge candidate flow
